cards.title: Your round 6 notes
cards.text: Dart dash 9, walls drawn whole in view, a double-star shard, one trait per stat card.
cards.why: Small fixes from the last deck. Mark any part that's off.
cards.details: Version 0.10.0. Close and reopen the app twice to get it.

parts.title: Dart dash 9
parts.text: Darts dash 9 cells; yours stays 5. Same Dash, different base length.

parts.title: Wall artifacts
parts.text: Walls are 4 thick now but sight only lit their first row, and missed bits of walls seen at a slant. Now the whole wall lights up when you see it.

parts.title: Shard
parts.text: A second, darker star underneath, turning the other way and pulsing a little.

parts.title: One trait each
parts.text: Cooldowns split into Spawn cooldown, Dash recharge and Reload, each its own card. Power is one card: damage.

cards.title: Four new statuses
cards.text: Chill, Shock, Poison and Mark join Burn as modules for any cast, with three mixes.
cards.why: Stage 4 part 2, from the design you approved. Numbers are first guesses.

parts.title: Chill
parts.text: Slows up to 60%. At 100 it freezes for 2 s; a hard hit on a frozen enemy shatters it and chills those near.

parts.title: Shock
parts.text: Each hit jumps to one more enemy. At 100 it stuns and jumps to three.

parts.title: Poison
parts.text: Slow damage. At 100 it rots 15% of their health. A poisoned enemy dies into a purple gas cloud that poisons others.

parts.title: Mark
parts.text: No damage; marked enemies take +25%. At 100 it detonates for 45. Pink pips show it.

parts.title: Mixes
parts.text: Burn on chill: both clear for a burst. Fire in a gas cloud: it explodes. Shock prefers marked enemies and jumps twice as far to them.

cards.title: The Hulk
cards.text: The first boss, at 5:00: a huge square rolling through the maze. Armoured in front, so hit it from behind.
cards.why: Stage 4's boss. It shoves everything, grinds through tiles, and drops an epic shard.
cards.details: 2400 health, comes back every 5 minutes half as tough again. Its front (the light bar) takes a quarter damage. A health bar shows at the top while it's alive.

cards.title: Keys and the door
cards.text: Three keepers in the farthest camps hold keys. Bring all 3 to the door for the next, harder floor.
cards.why: The door idea you said go to. Last piece of stage 4.
cards.details: Keepers are their camp's toughest enemy with +50% health and a gold ring. The door sits in the dead end farthest from the start. Through it: a new maze, enemies +25% health per floor, the wave timer starts again. Your build, level, health, time and boss timer carry over.
